City id tampere is unused in existing packs. Display Tampere. Agency Nysse (Tampereen joukkoliikenne); tram operated under contract by VR. Separate city from Helsinki — per docs/expansion-tracker/countries.csv's Finland light-pass guidance, HSL/Digitransit and Tampere/Waltti diverge at the realtime layer (separate GTFS-RT hosts, separate brokers), so per-city adapters are justified, not a merged Finland provider. No docs/finland-ledger.md exists yet (light pass only) — no cross-region stop-ownership conflict applies since Tampere and Helsinki share no stops.

City stays planned until Jim wires testers. Modes v1: Nysse tram lines 1 and 3 only, 33 unique stations (20 Line 1 + 17 Line 3 - 4 shared). No buses (out-mode, even where a tram stop shares a printed name with bus platforms — Keskustori, Rautatieasema, Sorin aukio all have lettered bus platforms alongside the tram A/B platforms). No VR regional/long-distance rail (out of catalog — the tram's Rautatieasema is a confirmed-separate, nearby stop-place from the VR railway station building, never in this catalog under any name).

There is no passenger Line 2 (corrected from the oracle report, hazard-pack.md H3 and the oracle report's own dated correction note) — the report's claim conflated a construction-phase label ('Part 2'/'Section 2A/2B' of Line 1's own Pyynikintori-to-Lentävänniemi extension) with a third line. Live GTFS routes.txt has exactly two route_type=0 (tram) rows: '1' and '3'. No station-graph change results from this correction — Santalahti and Lentävänniemi were already correctly Line 1 stops.
Timezone Europe/Helsinki HAS DST (EEST/EET), confirmed directly from the GTFS agency.txt agency_timezone field.

Two printed tram lines: 1 Kaupin kampus/Tays - Pyhällönpuisto (20 stops, via Keskustori), 3 Hervantajärvi - Sorin aukio (17 stops, via Hakametsä). 33 unique stations total (20 + 17 - 4 shared: Sammonaukio, Tulli, Rautatieasema, Koskipuisto).

Locked hub: Rautatieasema — the only central stop genuinely shared by both lines' printed routes, and adjacent to (but confirmed-separate from) the VR railway station. Keskustori is NOT an alternate candidate: live GTFS confirms Line 3 does not call at Keskustori at all (Koskipuisto -> Sorin aukio directly) — see direction-model-memo.md and hazard-pack.md H6.

Live-operations finding (hazard-pack.md H5, flagged for Jim's D2, not modelled here): a minority (~2-9%) of live GTFS trips tagged route 1 or 3 run through between the two lines' outer corridors (e.g. Pyhällönpuisto directly to Hervantajärvi), bypassing Kaupin kampus/TAYS or Sorin aukio. GTFS trip_headsign strings ('TAYS', 'Lentävänniemi', 'Hervanta', 'Sorin aukio') are also shorter/more ambiguous than the printed termini in two of four cases (TAYS is one stop short of Kaupin kampus; 'Hervanta' is ambiguous against five similarly-named stations) — see direction-model-memo.md for the recommended headsign-to-terminus mapping.

gtfsRouteIdsIfKnown are the printed passenger line codes (1, 3) — the only route_type=0 rows in the feed. stationRegistry stopIds are the GTFS stop_ids (both directional platforms A/B per station), resolved from the downloaded stops.txt this pass — never invented.

Feed / live (Jim D2, not a D1 generator): ITS Factory GTFS-RT vehicle-positions (http://data.itsfactory.fi/journeys/api/1/gtfs-rt/vehicle-positions, confirmed responding 200 this pass) and service-alerts (same host, confirmed responding 200) are live and unkeyed. GTFS-RT trip-updates is documented by the oracle report as living at a SEPARATE host (dev.publictransport.tampere.fi) rather than the itsfactory host (confirmed this pass: the itsfactory trip-updates path returns 404) — the exact trip-updates URL under dev.publictransport.tampere.fi was NOT independently confirmed this pass (it's a client-rendered SPA; every guessed path returned an identical shell page). A Digitransit-hosted 'waltti' routing profile also exists (POST https://api.digitransit.fi/routing/v2/waltti/gtfs/v1, confirmed responding with a subscription-key-required 401, i.e. the endpoint is real) but whether the existing DIGITRANSIT_SUBSCRIPTION_KEY's product scope covers 'waltti' (as opposed to just 'hsl', which Helsinki uses) was NOT confirmed this pass — flagged for Jim. Static GTFS is NOT a D1 generator. D1 stays planned. assertCityLive("tampere") must fail. Full detail in jim-handoff.md.

coverageGaps: Nysse buses (out-mode, even at tram stop-places that share a printed name with lettered bus platforms — Keskustori, Rautatieasema, and Sorin aukio all show additional lettered bus platforms in GTFS stops.txt alongside the tram A/B platforms).

VR regional/long-distance rail at Tampere railway station: out of catalog by station-set definition, not a service-level verdict. The tram's Rautatieasema (GTFS stop_ids 0809/0810) is a confirmed-separate, nearby stop-place from the VR station building (Wikipedia: 'The Rautatieasema tram stop is located near the railway station'). VR never appears in the ITS Factory GTFS feed at all. No verdict owed per docs/board-eligibility-rule.md.

Pirkkala/Linnainmaa extension (Sorin aukio -> Partola/Pirkkala and Kaupin kampus -> Ruotula/Linnainmaa, two further construction phases, ~2028 and ~2032): not on the current official stop list, not in any live GTFS trip. New stop names for phase 1 (~2028): Viinikanlahti, Hatanpää, Arboretum, Rantaperkiö, Härmälä, Härmälänranta, Partola, Ruotula. Phase 2 (~2032, state-funding-dependent) adds Pakkalankulma, Killo, Haikka, Pirkkala, Kaupinlaakso, Pappila, Linnainmaa. Not inserted.
No passenger line 2 or higher beyond 1 and 3. GTFS routes.txt confirms exactly two route_type=0 rows.
